title: Report a problem
whatPlaceholder: A sentence is enough, in any language.
context: The error you came from goes in too.
always: Always in: versions, system, PATH and SHELL, settings without personal details, agents' states, the hosts' recent events, and the logs and actions of the range. Keys are masked.
sensitive: Messages, detailed records and crash dumps may hold prompts, code and keys.
truncated: Showing the first 2 MB; the whole file goes in.
binary: This file goes in as it is and cannot be shown here.
signInToSubmit: Sign in to submit reports to Kettu and get an id for an issue.

notSubmitted.tooLarge: The report is too large to submit. Choose a shorter range or fewer extras, or save it and attach it to an issue.
notSubmitted.rateLimited: Too many reports were submitted today. Save this one and attach it to an issue, or submit it tomorrow.
notSubmitted.unauthorized: Your sign-in has ended. Sign in again, then submit.
notSubmitted.signedOut: This host is not signed in to a Kettu account. Sign it in, or save the report.
notSubmitted.network: Could not reach Kettu. Check the connection and submit again.
notSubmitted.failed: The report could not be submitted. Save it and attach it to an issue instead.

submitted.title: Report submitted
submitted.body: Put this id in an issue, so the report can be found from it.
